main_upgrade.summary: Added a monotonic snapshot contract and strengthened the publication watchdog so delayed writers cannot replace newer canonical or mirror dashboard evidence with an older snapshot.
main_upgrade.why: A delayed mirror sync on 2026-07-19 replaced a newer Evening snapshot with an older Strategic snapshot. Timestamp equality and successful workflow execution are insufficient when writer ordering can move the dashboard backwards.

portfolio.strongest_positive_change: Dashboard writers and recovery now have an explicit monotonic timestamp, blob-SHA and compare-and-swap gate that preserves the newest evidence.
portfolio.largest_risk: Provider/live proof and observed business KPI sources remain incomplete across several active projects.

metric_impact.before: A delayed writer could replace a newer mirror snapshot with an older validated snapshot.
metric_impact.after: Older candidates are rejected; canonical/mirror timestamps and blobs must move monotonically and finish identical.
metric_impact.evidence: monotonicity contract plus watchdog CAS rules

metric_impact.before: Snapshot race protection existed mainly in one automation prompt.
metric_impact.after: An active durable contract defines pre-write, decision, post-write and receipt gates.

evening_verification_questions: Did the controlled publisher apply the Morning record on top of the 2026-07-19T07:14:00+02:00 canonical snapshot without losing Daily Strategic Improve fields?
Do canonical and mirror finish with identical JSON blob SHAs and a timestamp not older than 2026-07-19T07:30:35+02:00?
Does the production content deploy identify the latest mirror source commit rather than an older recovery or receipt deploy?
Does the public receipt bind the exact current snapshot timestamp, mirror source commit and verified content deploy ID with all required UI checks true?
Did any delayed workflow attempt to move canonical or mirror backwards after this run?
unknown_blocked: Observed leads, orders, revenue, attendance and conversion remain uninstrumented for several active projects.
Current provider/live proof remains incomplete for Ezohata, EzoHata Finance, Psitherapy and Psihotavr.
Context/Retry Cost remains unknown because stable counters are unavailable.
The new exact snapshot remains STALE until its content deploy and public receipt are independently verified.

morning_handoff.action: Verify the exact Morning snapshot publication and receipt without allowing any older writer to overwrite it.
morning_handoff.expected_metric_effect: dashboard publication 2/4 -> 4/4 when exact receipt proof exists

agent_assessment.summary: The stale-writer failure class now has explicit timestamp monotonicity, blob equality, compare-and-swap, conflict recovery and receipt-bound publication rules.
agent_assessment.recommended_action: Keep the monotonic gate mandatory for every canonical, mirror and recovery write and add executable regression coverage in a later safe code cycle.

project_metric.name: Dashboard Snapshot Monotonicity Contract
project_metric.purpose: Prevent delayed writers and recovery jobs from replacing newer dashboard evidence with older snapshots.
project_metric.source: active monotonicity contract, watchdog rules and pre-write canonical/mirror evidence
project_metric.interpretation: The operational contract now rejects timestamp rollback, preserves newer evidence and requires exact post-write and receipt proof.
project_metric.next_action: Add an executable stale-writer regression to the canonical publisher when a safe code change is available.
